1.1: Betula nisset layyom harvii, vealmana layyom hachamishi. sheppaamayim bashshabbat batte dinin yoshvin baayarot, bayyom hashsheni uvayyom hachamishi, sheim haya lo taanat betulim, haya mashkim levet din:
1.2: Betula, ketubbatah matayim. vealmana, mane. betula almana, gerusha, vachalutza, min haerusin, ketubbatan matayim, veyesh lahen taanat betulim. haggiyyoret, vehashshevuya, vehashshifcha shennifdu veshennitgayyeru, veshennishtachreru, pechutot mibbenot shalosh shanim veyom echad, ketubbatan matayim, veyesh lahen taanat betulim:
1.3: Haggadol shebba al hakketanna, vekatan shebba al haggedola, umukkat etz, ketubbatan matayim, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, mukkat etz, ketubbatah mane:
1.4: Betula almana, gerusha, vachalutza, min hannissuin, ketubbatah mane, veen lahen taanat betulim. haggiyyoret, vehashshevuya, vehashshifcha, shennifdu, veshennitgayyeru, veshennishtachreru, yeterot al benot shalosh shanim veyom echad, ketubbatan mane, veen lahen taanat betulin:
1.5: Haochel etzel chamiv bihuda shello veedim, eno yachol liton taanat betulim, mippene shemmityached immah. achat almenat yisrael veachat almenat kohen, ketubbatan mane. bet din shel kohanim hayu govin labbetula arba meot zuz, velo michu veyadam chachamim:
1.6: Hannose et haishsha velo matza lah betulim, hi omeret, mishsheerastani neenasti, venistachafa sadecha. vehalla omer, lo chi, ella ad shello erastich, vehaya mikkachi mekkach taut. rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim, neemenet. rabbi yehoshua omer, lo mippiha anu chayyin, ella hare zo vechezkat beula ad shello titares, vehitattu, ad shettavi reaya lidvareha:
1.7: Hi omeret mukkat etz ani, vehu omer, lo chi, ella derusat ish at, rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim, neemenet. verabbi yehoshua omer, lo mippiha anu chayyin, ella hare zo vechezkat derusat ish, ad shettavi reaya lidvareha:
1.8: Rauha medabberet im echad bashshuk, amru lah ma tivo shel ze. ish peloni vechohen hu. rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim, neemenet. verabbi yehoshua omer, lo mippiha anu chayyin, ella hare zo vechezkat beula lenatin ulemamzer, ad shettavi reaya lidvareha:
1.9: Hayta meubberet, veamru lah ma tivo shel ubbar ze. meish peloni vechohen hu. rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim, neemenet. rabbi yehoshua omer, lo mippiha anu chayyin, ella hare zo vechezkat meubberet lenatin ulemamzer, ad shettavi reaya lidvareha:
1.10: Amar rabbi yose, maase vetinoket sheyyarda lemallot mayim min haayin, veneensa. amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri, im rov anshe hair massiin lakkehunna, hare zo tinnase lakkehunna:

2.1: Haishsha shennitarmela o shennitgarsha, hi omeret betula nesatani, vehu omer, lo chi ella almana nesatich, im yesh edim sheyyatzat behinnuma veroshah parua, ketubbatah matayim. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, af chilluk kelayot reaya:
2.2: Umode rabbi yehoshua beomer lachavero sade zo shel avicha hayta ulekachtiha hemennu, shehu neeman, shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. veim yesh edim shehi shel aviv vehu omer lekachtiha hemennu, eno neeman:
2.3: Haedim sheamru ketav yadenu hu ze, aval anusim hayinu, ketannim hayinu, pesule edut hayinu, hare ellu neemanim. veim yesh edim shehu chetav yadam o shehaya chetav yadam yotze mimmakom acher, enan neemanin:
2.4: Ze omer ze chetav yadi veze chetav yado shel chaveri, veze omer ze chetav yadi veze chetav yado shel chaveri, hare ellu neemanin. ze omer ze chetav yadi veze omer ze chetav yadi, tzerichim letzaref immahem acher, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim, enan tzerichin letzaref immahem acher, ella neeman adam lomar ze chetav yadi:
2.5: Haishsha sheamra eshet ish hayiti ugerusha ani, neemenet, shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. veim yesh edim shehayta eshet ish vehi omeret gerusha ani, enah neemenet. amra nishbeti utehora ani, neemenet, shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. veim yesh edim shennishbet vehi omeret tehora ani, enah neemenet. veim mishshennisset bau edim, hare zo lo tetze:
2.6: Shete nashim shennishbu, zot omeret nishbeti utehora ani, vezot omeret nishbeti utehora ani, enan neemanot. uvizman shehen meidot zo et zo, hare ellu neemanot:
2.7: Vechen shene anashim, ze omer kohen ani veze omer kohen ani, enan neemanin. uvizman shehen meidin ze et ze, hare ellu neemanin:
2.8: Rabbi yehuda omer, en maalin lakkehunna al pi ed echad. amar rabbi elazar, ematay, bimkom sheyyesh orrin. aval bimkom sheen orrin, maalin lakkehunna al pi ed echad. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi shimon ben hassegan, maalin lakkehunna al pi ed echad:
2.9: Haishsha shennechbesha vide goyim al yede mamon, mutteret levalah. al yede nefashot, asura levalah. ir shekkevashah karkom, kol kohanot shennimtzeu vetochah, pesulot. veim yesh lahen edim, afillu eved, afillu shifcha, hare ellu neemanin. veen neeman adam al yede atzmo. amar rabbi zecharya ven hakkatztzav, hammaon hazze, lo zaza yadah mittoch yadi mishshaa shennichnesu goyim lirushalayim vead sheyyatzau. amru lo, en adam meid al yede atzmo:
2.10: Veelu neemanin lehaid begadlan ma sherau vekatnan. neeman adam lomar, ze chetav yado shel abba, veze chetav yado shel rabbi, veze chetav yado shel achi. zachur hayiti viflonit sheyyatzta vehinnuma, veroshah parua. veshehaya ish peloni yotze mibbet hassefer litbol leechol batteruma. veshehaya cholek immanu al haggoren. vehammakom hazze bet happeras. vead kan hayinu vain beshabbat. aval en adam neeman lomar, derech haya lifloni vammakom hazze, maamad umisped haya lifloni vammakom hazze:

3.1: Ellu nearot sheyyesh lahen kenas. habba al hammamzeret, veal hannetina, veal hakkutit. habba al haggiyyoret, veal hashshevuya, veal hashshifcha, shennifdu veshennitgayyeru veshennishtachreru pechutot mibbenot shalosh shanim veyom echad. habba al achoto, veal achot aviv, veal achot immo, veal achot ishto, veal eshet achiv, veal eshet achi aviv, veal hannidda, yesh lahen kenas. af al pi shehen behikkaret, en bahen mitat bet din:
3.2: Veellu sheen lahen kenas, habba al haggiyyoret veal hashshevuya veal hashshifcha shennifdu veshennitgayyeru veshennishtachreru yeterot al benot shalosh shanim veyom echad. rabbi yehuda omer, shevuya shennifdet, hare hi vikdushshatah, af al pi sheggedola. habba al bitto, al bat bitto, al bat beno, al bat ishto, al bat benah, al bat bittah, en lahen kenas, mippene shemmitchayyev benafsho, shemmitato vide vet din. vechol hammitchayyev benafsho, en meshallem mamon, shenneemar (Shemot 21) velo yihye ason anosh yeanesh:
3.3: Naara shennitarsa venitgarsha, rabbi yose haggelili omer, en lah kenas. rabbi akiva omer, yesh lah kenas, ukenasah leatzmah:
3.4: Hamefatte noten shelosha devarim, vehaones arbaa. hamefatte noten boshet ufegam ukenas. mosif alav ones, shennoten et hatztzaar. ma ben ones limfatte. haones noten et hatztzaar, vehamefatte eno noten et hatztzaar. haones noten miyyad, vehamefatte lichsheyyotzi. haones shote vaatzitzo, vehamefatte im ratza lehotzi, motzi:
3.5: Ketzad shote vaatzitzo, afillu hi chiggeret, afillu hi suma, vaafillu hayta mukkat shechin. nimtza vah devar erva, o sheenah reuya lavo veyisrael, eno rashshay lekayyemah, shenneemar, (Devarim 22) velo tihye leishsha, ishsha haruya lo:
3.6: Yetoma shennitarsa venitgarsha, rabbi elazar omer, hamefatte fatur, vehaones chayyav:
3.7: Ezohi voshet, hakkol lefi hamevayyesh vehammitbayyesh. pegam, roin otah keillu hi shifcha nimkeret, kamma hayta yafa vechamma hi yafa. kenas, shave vechol adam. vechol sheyyesh lo kitzba min hattora, shave vechol adam:
3.8: Kol makom sheyyesh mecher, en kenas. vechol makom sheyyesh kenas, en mecher. ketanna yesh lah mecher veen lah kenas. naara yesh lah kenas veen lah mecher. habbogeret en lah lo mecher velo kenas:
3.9: Haomer pittiti et bitto shel peloni, meshallem boshet ufegam al pi atzmo, veeno meshallem kenas. haomer ganavti vetavachti umacharti, meshallem et hakkeren al pi atzmo, veeno meshallem tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha. hemit shori et peloni o shoro shel peloni, hare ze meshallem al pi atzmo. hemit shori avdo shel peloni, eno meshallem al pi atzmo. ze hakkelal kol hameshallem yater al ma shehizzik, eno meshallem al pi atzmo:

4.1: Naara shennitpatteta, bashtah ufegamah ukenasah shel aviha, vehatztzaar battefusa. amda vaddin ad shello met haav, hare hen shel av. met haav, hare hen shel achin. lo hispika laamod baddin ad shemmet haav, hare hen shel atzmah. amda vaddin ad shello vagra, hare hen shel av. met haav, hare hen shel achin. lo hispika laamod baddin ad shebbagra, hare hen shel atzmah. rabbi shimon omer, im lo hispika ligbot ad shemmet haav, hare hen shel atzmah. maase yadeha umetziatah, af al pi shello gavta, met haav, hare hen shel achin:
4.2: Hameares et bitto, vegershah, ersah venitarmela, ketubbatah shello. hissiah vegershah, hissiah venitarmela, ketubbatah shellah. rabbi yehuda omer, harishona shel av. amru lo, mishshehissiah, en leaviha reshut bah:
4.3: Haggiyyoret shennitgayyera vittah immah, vezinneta, hare zo bechenek. en lah lo fetach bet haav, velo mea sala. hayta horatah shello vikdushsha veledatah bikdushsha, hare zo viskila. en lah lo fetach bet haav velo mea sala. hayta horatah veledatah bikdushsha, hare hi chevat yisrael lechol davar. yesh lah av veen lah petach bet haav, yesh lah petach bet haav veen lah av, hare zo viskila. lo neemar petach bet aviha, ella lemitzva:
4.4: Haav zakkay vevitto vekiddusheha, bakkesef bashshetar uvabbia, vezakkay bimtziatah, uvemaase yadeha, uvahafarat nedareha. umekabbel et gittah, veeno ochel perot bechayyeha. nisset, yater alav habbaal sheochel perot bechayyeha, vechayyav bimzonoteha, befirkonah, uvikvuratah. rabbi yehuda omer, afillu ani shebbeyisrael, lo yifchot mishshene chalilim umekonanet:
4.5: Leolam hi virshut haav, ad shettikkanes lirshut habbaal lannissuin. masar haav lishluche habbaal, hare hi virshut habbaal. halach haav im sheluche habbaal, o shehalchu sheluche haav im sheluche habbaal, hare hi virshut haav. masru sheluche haav lishluche habbaal, hare hi virshut habbaal:
4.6: Haav eno chayyav bimzonot bitto. ze midrash darash rabbi elazar ben azarya lifne chachamim bakkerem beyavne, habbanim yirshu vehabbanot yizzonu, ma habbanim enan yorshin ella leachar mitat haav, af habbanot enan nizzonot ella leachar mitat avihen:
4.7: Lo chatav lah ketubba, betula gova matayim, vealmana mane, mippene shehu tenay bet din. katav lah, sade shave mane tachat matayim zuz, velo chatav lah, kol nechasim deit li acharain lichtubbetich, chayyav, shehu tenay bet din:
4.8: Lo chatav lah, im tishtabbai efrekinnach veotvinnach li leintu, uvechohenet, ahadrinnach limdintach, chayyav, shehu tenay bet din:
4.9: Nishbet, chayyav lifdotah. veim amar, hare gittah uchetubbatah, tifde et atzmah, eno rashshay. lakta, chayyav lerappotah. amar, hare gittah uchetubbatah, terappe et atzmah, rashshay:
4.10: Lo chatav lah, benin dichrin deyehevon lichi minnay innun yirtun kesaf ketubbetich yater al chulekehon deim achuhon, chayyav shehu tenay bet din:
4.11: Benan nukvin deyehevyan lichi minnay, yehevyan yatvan beveti umittezanan minnichsay ad detinnassevan leguvrin, chayyav, shehu tenay bet din:
4.12: At tehe yatva beveti umittezana minnichsay, kol yeme miggad almenutich beveti, chayyav, shehu tenay bet din. kach hayu anshe yerushalayim kotvin. anshe galil hayu chotvin keanshe yerushalayim. anshe yehuda hayu chotvin, ad sheyyirtzu hayyorshim litten lich ketubbetich. lefichach im ratzu hayyorshin, notnin lah ketubbatah ufotrin otah:

5.1: Af al pi sheamru, betula gova matayim vealmana mane, im ratza lehosif, afillu mea mane, yosif. nitarmela o nitgarsha, ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin, gova et hakkol. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, min hannissuin, gova et hakkol. min haerusin, betula gova matayim vealmana mane, shello chatav lah ella al menat lechansah. rabbi yehuda omer, im ratza, kotev livtula shetar shel matayim, vehi chotevet, hitkabbalti mimmecha mane, ulealmana, mane, vehi chotevet, hitkabbalti mimmecha chamishshim zuz. rabbi meir omer, kol happochet livtula mimmatayim ulealmana mimmane, hare zo veilat zenut:
5.2: Notnin livtula shenem asar chodesh mishshettevaah habbaal lefarnes et atzmah. ucheshem shennotnin laishsha, kach notnin laish lefarnes et atzmo. ulealmana sheloshim yom. higgia zeman velo nissau, ochlot mishshello veochlot batteruma. rabbi tarfon omer, notnin lah hakkol teruma. rabbi akiva omer, mechetza chullin umechetza teruma:
5.3: Hayyavam eno maachil batteruma. asta shishsha chodashim bifne habbaal veshishsha chodashim bifne hayyavam, vaafillu chullan bifne habbaal chaser yom echad bifne hayyavam, o chullan bifne hayyavam chaser yom echad bifne habbaal, enah ochelet batteruma. zo mishna rishona. bet din shel acharehen amru, en haishsha ochelet batteruma, ad shettikkanes lachuppa:
5.4: Hammakdish maase yede ishto, hare zo osa veochelet. hammotar, rabbi meir omer, hekdesh. rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer, chullin:
5.5: Ellu melachot shehaishsha osa levalah, tochenet, veofa, umechabbeset, mevashshelet, umenika et benah, matztzaat lo hammitta, veosa vatztzemer. hichnisa lo shifcha achat, lo tochenet, velo ofa velo mechabbeset. shetayim, enah mevashshelet veenah menika et benah. shalosh, enah matztzaat lo hammitta veenah osa vatztzemer. arbaa, yoshevet bakkattedra. rabbi eliezer omer, afillu hichnisa lo mea shefachot, kofah laasot batztzemer, shehabbattala mevia lide zimma. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af hammaddir et ishto millaasot melacha, yotzi veyitten ketubbatah, shehabbattala mevia lide shiamum:
5.6: Hammaddir et ishto mittashmish hammitta, bet shammay omrim, shete shabbatot. bet hillel omrim, shabbat echat. hattalmidim yotzin letalmud tora shello virshut, sheloshim yom. happoalim, shabbat echat. haona haamura vattora, hattayyalin, bechol yom. happoalim, shetayim bashshabbat. hachammarim, achat bashshabbat. haggammalim, achat lishloshim yom. hassappanim, achat leshishsha chodashim, divre rabbi eliezer:
5.7: Hammoredet al balah, pochatin lah mikketubbatah shiva dinarin bashshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer, shiva tarpeikin. ad matay hu fochet, ad keneged ketubbatah. rabbi yose omer, leolam hu fochet veholech, shemma tippol lah yerushsha mimmakom acher, gove hemenna. vechen hammored al ishto, mosifin lah al ketubbatah shelosha dinarin bashshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer, shelosha tarpeikin:
5.8: Hammashre et ishto al yede shalish, lo yifchot lah mishshene kabbin chittin, o mearbaa kabbin seorim. amar rabbi yose, lo fasak lah seorim ella rabbi yishmael shehaya samuch leedom. venoten lah chatzi kav kitnit vachatzi log shemen, vekav gerogarot, o mane devela. veim en lo, posek leummatan perot mimmakom acher. venoten lah mitta, mappatz, umachatzelet. venoten lah kippa leroshah, vachagor lematneha, uminalim mimmoed lemoed, vechelim shel chamishshim zuz mishshana leshana. veen notnin lah, lo chadashim bimot hachamma, velo shechakim bimot haggeshamim. ella noten lah kelim shel chamishshim zuz bimot haggeshamim, vehi mitkassa vivlaotehen bimot hachamma, vehashshechakim shellah:
5.9: Noten lah maa chesef letzarkah, veochelet immo millele shabbat lelele shabbat. veim en noten lah maa chesef letzarkah, maase yadeha shellah. uma hi osa lo, mishkal chamesh selaim sheti bihuda, shehen eser selaim baggalil, o mishkal eser selaim erev bihuda, shehen esrim selaim baggalil. veim hayta menika, pochatim lah mimmaase yadeha, umosifin lah al mezonoteha. bamme devarim amurim, beani shebbeyisrael. aval bimchubbad, hakkol lefi chevodo:

6.1: Metziat haishsha umaase yadeha, levalah. virushshatah, hu ochel perot bechayyeha. bashtah ufegamah, shellah. rabbi yehuda ven betera omer, bizman shebbasseter, lah shene chalakim, velo echad. uvizman shebbaggaluy, lo shene chalakim, velah echad. shello, yinnaten miyyad. veshellah, yillakach bahen karka, vehu ochel perot:
6.2: Happosek maot lachatano, umet chatano, amru chachamim, yachol hu sheyyomar, leachicha hayiti rotze litten, ulecha i efshi litten:
6.3: Paska lehachenis lo elef dinar, hu fosek kenegdan chamishsha asar mane. ucheneged hashshum, hu fosek pachot chomesh. shum bemane veshave mane, en lo ella mane. shum bemane, hi notenet sheloshim veechad sela vedinar. uvearba meot, hi notenet chamesh meot. ma shechatan posek, hu fosek pachot chomesh:
6.4: Paska lehachenis lo chesafim, sela kesef naase shishsha dinarim. hechatan mekabbel alav asara dinarin lakkuppa, lechol mane umane. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, hakkol keminhag hammedina:
6.5: Hammassi et bitto setam, lo yifchot lah mechamishshim zuz. pasak lehachenisah arumma, lo yomar habbaal kesheachnisah leveti achassenna vichsuti, ella mechassah veodah bevet aviha. vechen hammassi et hayetoma, lo yifchot lah mechamishshim zuz. im yesh bakkis, mefarnesin otah lefi chevodah:
6.6: Yetoma shehissiatta immah o acheha middatah, vechatvu lah bemea o vachamishshim zuz, yechola hi mishshettagdil lehotzi miyyadan ma sherauy lehinnaten lah. rabbi yehuda omer, im hissi et habbat harishona, yinnaten lashsheniyya chederech shennatan larishona. vachachamim omrim, peamim sheadam ani veheeshir o ashir veheeni, ella shamin et hannechasim venotnin lah:
6.7: Hammashlish maot levitto, vehi omeret neeman bali alay, yaase hashshalish ma shehushlash beyado, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, vechi enah ella sade vehi rotza lemachrah, hare hi mechura meachshav. bamme devarim amurim, bigdola. aval biktanna, en maase ketanna chelum:

7.1: Hammaddir et ishto millehanot lo, ad sheloshim yom, yaamid parnas. yater mikken, yotzi veyitten ketubba. rabbi yehuda omer, beyisrael, chodesh echad yekayyem, ushenayim, yotzi veyitten ketubba. uvechohenet, shenayim yekayyem, ushelosha, yotzi veyitten ketubba:
7.2: Hammaddir et ishto shello titom achad mikkol happerot, yotzi veyitten ketubba. rabbi yehuda omer, beyisrael, yom echad yekayyem, shenayim, yotzi veyitten ketubba. uvechohenet, shenayim yekayyem, shelosha, yotzi veyitten ketubba:
7.3: Hammaddir et ishto shello titkashshet beachad mikkol hamminin, yotzi veyitten ketubba. rabbi yose omer, baaniyyot, shello natan kitzba. uvaashirot, sheloshim yom:
7.4: Hammaddir et ishto shello telech levet aviha, bizman shehu immah bair, chodesh echad yekayyem. shenayim, yotzi veyitten ketubba. uvizman shehu veir acheret, regel echad yekayyem. shelosha, yotzi veyitten ketubba:
7.5: Hammaddir et ishto shello telech levet haevel o levet hammishte, yotzi veyitten ketubba, mippene shennoel befaneha. veim haya toen mishshum davar acher, rashshay. amar lah, al menat shettomri lifloni ma sheamart li o ma sheamarti lach, o shettehe memallea umeara laashpa, yotzi veyitten ketubba:
7.6: Veellu yotzot shello vichtubba, haoveret al dat moshe vihudit. veezo hi dat moshe, maachilato sheeno meussar, umeshammashto nidda, velo kotza lah challa, venoderet veenah mekayyemet. veezohi dat yehudit, yotza veroshah parua, vetova vashshuk, umedabberet im kol adam. abba shaul omer, af hamekallelet yoldav befanav. rabbi tarfon omer, af hakkolanit. veezo hi kolanit, lichshehi medabberet betoch betah ushecheneha shomin kolah:
7.7: Hamekaddesh et haishsha al menat sheen aleha nedarim venimtzeu aleha nedarim, enah mekuddeshet. kenasah setam venimtzeu aleha nedarim, tetze shello vichtubba. al menat sheen bah mumin venimtzeu vah mumin, enah mekuddeshet. kenasah setam venimtzeu vah mumin, tetze shello vichtubba. kol hammumin happoslin bakkohanim, poslin bannashim:
7.8: Hayu vah mumin veodah bevet aviha, haav tzarich lehavi reaya shemmishshennitarsa noldu vah mumin hallalu venistachafa sadehu. nichnesa lirshut habbaal, habbaal tzarich lehavi reaya shead shello nitarsa hayu vah mumin ellu vehaya mikkacho mekkach taut, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, bamme devarim amurim, bemumin shebbasseter. aval bemumin shebbaggaluy, eno yachol liton. veim yesh merchatz beotah hair, af mumin shebbasseter eno yachol liton, mippene shehu vodkah bikrovotav:
7.9: Haish shennoldu vo mumin, en kofin oto lehotzi. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, bamme devarim amurim, bammumin hakketannim. aval bammumin haggedolim, kofin oto lehotzi:
7.10: Veellu shekkofin oto lehotzi, mukke shechin, uvaal polippos, vehamekammetz, vehametzaref nechoshet, vehabbursi, ben shehayu vam ad shello nisseu uven mishshennisseu noladu. veal kullan amar rabbi meir, af al pi shehitna immah, yecholah hi shettomar, sevura hayiti sheani yecholah lekabbel, veachshav eni yechola lekabbel. vachachamim omrim, mekabbelet hi al karchah, chutz mimmukke shechin, mippene shemmemikkato. maase vetzidon bevursi echad shemmet vehaya lo ach bursi, amru chachamim, yechola hi shettomar, leachicha hayiti yechola lekabbel, ulecha eni yechola lekabbel:

8.1: Haishsha shennaflu lah nechasim ad shello titares, modim bet shammay uvet hillel shemmocheret venotenet vekayyam. naflu lah mishshennitarsa, bet shammay omrim, timkor, uvet hillel omrim, lo timkor. ellu vaellu modim, sheim machra venatna, kayyam. amar rabbi yehuda, amru lifne rabban gamliel, hoil vezacha vaishsha, lo yizke vannechasim. amar lahem, al hachadashim anu voshin, ella shaattem megalgelin alenu et hayeshanim. naflu lah mishshennisset, ellu vaellu modim sheim machra venatna shehabbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot. ad shello nisset venisset, rabban gamliel omer, im machra venatna, kayyam. amar rabbi chanina ben akiva, amru lifne rabban gamliel, hoil vezacha vaishsha, lo yizke vannechasim. amar lahem, al hachadashim anu voshin, ella sheattem megalgelim alenu et hayeshanim:
8.2: Rabbi shimon cholek ben nechasim linchasim. nechasim hayeduim labbaal, lo timkor. veim machra venatna, batel. sheenan yeduim labbaal, lo timkor. veim machra venatna, kayyam:
8.3: Naflu lah kesafim, yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. perot hattelushin min hakkarka, yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. vehamechubbarin bakkarka, amar rabbi meir, shamin otan kamma hen yafin beferot vechamma hen yafin belo ferot, vehammotar, yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. vachachamim omrim, hamechubbarin lakkarka, shello. vehattelushin min hakkarka, shellah, veyillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot:
8.4: Rabbi shimon omer, mekom sheyyafe chocho vichnisatah, hura kocho vitziatah. mekom shehura kocho vichnisatah, yafe chocho vitziatah. perot hamechubbarin lakkarka, bichnisatah shello uvitziatah shellah. vehattelushin min hakkarka, bichnisatah shellah uvitziatah shello:
8.5: Naflu lah avadim ushefachot zekenim, yimmachru veyillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, lo timkor, mippene shehen shevach bet aviha. naflu lah zetim ugefanim zekenim, yimmachru leetzim veyillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. rabbi yehuda omer, lo timkor, mippene shehen shevach bet aviha. hammotzi hotzaot al nichse ishto, hotzi harebe veachal kima, kima veachal harebe, ma shehotzi hotzi, uma sheachal achol. hotzi velo achal, yishshava kamma hotzi veyittol:
8.6: Shomeret yavam shennaflu lah nechasim, modim bet shammay uvet hillel shemmocheret venotenet vekayyam. meta, ma yaasu vichtubbatah uvannechasim hannichnasin vehayyotzin immah. bet shammay omrim, yachaloku yorshe habbaal im yorshe haav. uvet hillel omrim, nechasim bechezkatan, ketubba bechezkat yorshe habbaal, nechasim hannichnasim vehayyotzim immah bechezkat yorshe haav:
8.7: Hinniach achiv maot, yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. perot hattelushin min hakkarka, yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. hamechubbarin bakkarka, amar rabbi meir, shamin otan kamma hen yafin beferot vechamma hen yafin belo ferot, vehammotar, yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. vachachamim omrim, perot hamechubbarim bakkarka, shello. vehattelushin min hakkarka, kol hakkodem zacha vahen. kadam hu, zacha. kadma hi, yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. kenasah, hare hi cheishto lechol davar, uvilvad shettehe chetubbatah al nichse valah harishon:
8.8: Lo yomar lah, hare chetubbetich munnachat al hashshulchan, ella kol nechasav acharain lakketubba. vechen lo yomar adam leishto, hare chetubbetich munnachat al hashshulchan, ella chol nechasav acharain lichtubbatah. gershah, en lah ella chetubbatah. hechezirah, hare hi kechol hannashim veen lah ella chetubbatah bilvad:

9.1: Hakkotev leishto, din udevarim en li vinchasayich, hare ze ochel perot bechayyeha. veim meta, yorshah. im ken lamma chatav lah din udevarim en li vinchasayich, sheim machra venatna, kayyam. katav lah, din udevarim en li vinchasayich uveferotehen, hare ze eno ochel perot bechayyeha. veim meta, yorshah. rabbi yehuda omer, leolam ochel pere ferot, ad sheyyichtov lah din udevarim en li vinchasayich uveferotehen uvefere ferotehen ad olam. katav lah, din udevarim en li vinchasayich uveferotehen uvefere ferotehen bechayyayich uvemotech, eno ochel perot bechayyeha. veim meta, eno yorshah. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, im meta, yirashenna, mippene shehitna al ma shekkatuv battora, vechol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora, tenao vatel:
9.2: Mi shemmet vehinniach ishsha uvaal chov veyorshin, vehaya lo fikkadon o milve beyad acherim, rabbi tarfon omer, yinnatnu lakkoshel shebbahen. rabbi akiva omer, en merachamin baddin, ella yinnatnu layyorshin, shekkullan tzerichin shevua veen hayyorshin tzerichin shevua:
9.3: Hinniach perot telushin min hakkarka, kol hakkodem zacha vahen. zachta ishsha yoter mikketubbatah, uvaal chov yoter al chovo, hammotar, rabbi tarfon omer, yinnatnu lakkoshel shebbahen. rabbi akiva omer, en merachamin baddin, ella yinnatnu layyorshim, shekkullam tzerichin shevua veen hayyorshim tzerichin shevua:
9.4: Hammoshiv et ishto chenvanit o shemminnah appotroppa, hare ze mashbiah kol zeman sheyyirtze. rabbi eliezer omer, afillu al pilkah veal issatah:
9.5: Katav lah, neder ushevua en li alayich, en yachol lehashebiah, aval mashbia hu et yorsheha veet habbaim birshutah. neder ushevua en li alayich veal yorshayich veal habbaim birshutich, eno yachol lehashebiah, lo hi velo yorsheha velo et habbaim birshutah. aval yorshav mashbiin otah, veet yorsheha veet habbaim birshutah. neder ushevua en li velo leyorshay velo labbaim birshuti alayich veal yorshayich veal habbaim birshutich, eno yachol lehashebiah, lo hu velo yorshav velo habbaim birshuto, lo otah velo yorsheha velo habbain birshutah:
9.6: Halcha mikkever balah levet aviha o shechazra levet chamiha, velo naaset appotroppa, en hayyorshin mashbiin otah. veim naaset appotroppa, hayyorshin mashbiin otah al heatid lavo veen mashbiin otah al ma sheavar:
9.7: Happogemet ketubbatah, lo tippara ella vishvua. ed echad meidah shehi ferua, lo tippara ella vishvua. minnichse yetomim uminnechasim meshubadin veshello vefanav, lo tippara ella vishvua:
9.8: Happogemet ketubbatah ketzad, hayta chetubbatah elef zuz, veamar lah hitkabbalt ketubbatech, vehi omeret lo hitkabbalti ella mane, lo tippara ella vishvua. ed echad meidah shehi ferua ketzad, hayta chetubbatah elef zuz, veamar lah hitkabbalt ketubbatech, vehi omeret lo hitkabbalti, veed echad meidah shehi ferua, lo tippara ella vishvua. minnechasim meshubadim ketzad, machar nechasav laacherim, vehi nifraat min hallakochot, lo tippara ella vishvua. minnichse yetomim ketzad, met vehinniach nechasav laytomim, vehi nifraat min hayetomim, lo tippara ella vishvua. veshello befanav ketzad, halach lo limdinat hayyam, vehi nifraat shello vefanav, enah nifraat ella vishvua. rabbi shimon omer, kol zeman shehi tovaat ketubbatah, hayyorshin mashbiin otah. veim enah tovaat ketubbatah, en hayyorshin mashbiin otah:
9.9: Hotzia get veen immo chetubba, gova chetubbatah. ketubba veen immah get, hi omeret avad gitti vehu omer avad shovri, vechen baal chov shehotzi shetar chov veen immo ferozbul, hare ellu lo yippareu. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, min hassakkana veelach, ishsha gova chetubbatah shello veget, uvaal chov gove shello vifrozbul. shene gittin ushete chetubbot, gova shete chetubbot. shete chetubbot veget echad, o chetubba ushene gittin, o chetubba veget umita, enah gova ella chetubba achat, shehamegaresh et ishto vehechezirah, al menat ketubba harishona machazirah. katan shehissio aviv, ketubbatah kayyemet, sheal menat ken kiyyemah. ger shennitgayyer veishto immo, ketubbatah kayyemet, sheal menat ken kiyyemah:

10.1: Mi shehaya nasuy shete nashim umet, harishona kodemet lashsheniyya, veyorshe harishona kodmin leyorshe sheniyya. nasa et harishona vameta, nasa sheniyya umet hu, sheniyya veyorsheha kodmim leyorshe harishona:
10.2: Mi shehaya nasuy shete nashim umetu veachar kach met hu, vitomim mevakshim ketubbat imman veen sham ella shete chetubbot, cholkin beshave. haya sham motar dinar, ellu notlin ketubbat imman veellu notlin ketubbat imman. im amru yetomim, anachnu maalim al nichse avinu yater dinar, kede sheyyittelu chetubbat imman, en shomin lahen, ella shamin et hannechasim bevet din:
10.3: Hayu sham nechasim barauy, enan kevammuchzak. rabbi shimon omer, afillu yesh sham nechasim sheen lahem acharayut, eno chelum, ad sheyyihyu sham nechasim sheyyesh lahen acharayut yoter al shete hakketubbot dinar:
10.4: Mi shehaya nasuy shalosh nashim umet, ketubbatah shel zo mane veshel zo matayim veshel zo shelosh meot veen sham ella mane, cholkot beshave. hayu sham matayim, shel mane notelet chamishshim, shel matayim veshel shelosh meot, shelosha shelosha shel zahav. hayu sham shelosh meot, shel mane notelet chamishshim, veshel matayim, mane, veshel shelosh meot, shishsha shel zahav. vechen shelosha shehittilu lechis, pichatu o hotiru, kach hen cholkin:
10.5: Mi shehaya nasuy arba nashim umet, harishona kodemet lashsheniyya, usheniyya lashshelishit, ushelishit larviit. harishona nishbaat lashsheniyya, usheniyya lashshelishit, ushelishit larviit, veharviit nifraat shello vishvua. ben nannas omer, vechi mippene shehi acharona niskeret, af hi lo tippara ella vishvua. hayu yotzot kullan beyom echad, kol hakkodemet lachavertah afillu shaa achat, zachta. vechach hayu chotvin birushalayim shaot. hayu chullan yotzot beshaa achat veen sham ella mane, cholkot beshave:
10.6: Mi shehaya nasuy shete nashim, umachar et sadehu, vechatva rishona lallokeach din udevarim en li immach, hashsheniyya motzia mehallokeach, verishona min hashsheniyya, vehallokeach min harishona, vechozrot chalila ad sheyyaasu feshara venehem. vechen baal chov. vechen ishsha vaalat chov:

11.1: Almana nizzonet minnichse yetomim, maase yadeha shellahen, veen chayyavin bikvuratah. yorsheha, yorshe chetubbatah, chayyavin bikvuratah:
11.2: Almana, ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin, mocheret shello bevet din. rabbi shimon omer, min hannissuin, mocheret shello bevet din. min haerusin, lo timkor ella bevet din, mippene sheen lah mezonot, vechol sheen lah mezonot, lo timkor ella bevet din:
11.3: Machra chetubbatah o miktzatah, mishkena chetubbatah o miktzatah, natna chetubbatah leacher o miktzatah, lo timkor et hashshear ella bevet din. vachachamim omrim, mocheret hi afillu arbaa vachamishsha feamim, umocheret limzonot shello bevet din, vechotevet, limzonot macharti. ugerusha lo timkor ella bevet din:
11.4: Almana shehayta chetubbatah matayim umachra shave mane vematayim o shave matayim bemane, nitkabbela chetubbatah. hayta chetubbatah mane umachra shave mane vedinar bemane, michrah batel. afillu hi omeret achazir et haddinar layyorshin, michrah batel. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, leolam michrah kayyam ad shettehe sham kede shetteshayyer besade bat tisha kabbim, uveginna bat chatzi kav, uchedivre rabbi akiva bet rova. hayta chetubbatah arba meot zuz, umachra laze vemane velaze vemane velaacharon yafe mane vedinar bemane, shel acharon batel veshel kullan michran kayyam:
11.5: Shum haddayyanin sheppichatu shetut o hosifu shetut, michran batel. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, michran kayyam. im ken ma koach bet din yafe. aval im asu iggeret bikkoret, afillu machru shave mane bematayim, o shave matayim bemane, michran kayyam:
11.6: Hamemaenet, hashsheniyya, vehaaylonit, en lahem ketubba velo ferot, velo mezonot, velo velaot. veim mittechilla nesaah leshem aylonit, yesh lah ketubba. almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lenatin ulemamzer, yesh lahen ketubba:

12.1: Hannose et haishsha ufaska immo kede sheyyazun et bittah chamesh shanim, chayyav lezunah chamesh shanim. nisset leacher ufaska immo kede sheyyazun et bittah chamesh shanim, chayyav lezunah chamesh shanim. lo yomar harishon lichshettavo etzli azunah, ella molich lah mezonoteha limkom immah. vechen lo yomru shenehem hare anu zanin otah keechad, ella echad zanah veechad noten lah deme mezonot:
12.2: Nisset, habbaal noten lah mezonot vehen notnin lah deme mezonot. metu, benotehen nizzonot minnechasim bene chorin vehi nizzonet minnechasim meshubadim, mippene shehi chevaalat chov. happikchim hayu chotvim, al menat sheazun et bittech chamesh shanim kol zeman sheat immi:
12.3: Almana sheamra i efshi lazuz mibbet bali, en hayyorshin yecholin lomar lah lechi levet avich veanu zanin otach, ella zanin otah bevet balah venotnin lah mador lefi chevodah. amra i efshi lazuz mibbet abba, yecholim hayyorshim lomar lah, im at etzlenu yesh lich mezonot, veim en at etzlenu en lich mezonot. im hayta toenet mippene shehi yalda vehen yeladim, zanin otah vehi bevet aviha:
12.4: Kol zeman shehi vevet aviha, gova chetubbatah leolam. kol zeman shehi bevet balah, gova chetubbatah ad esrim vechamesh shanim, sheyyesh beesrim vechamesh shanim shettaase tova cheneged ketubbatah, divre rabbi meir sheamar mishshum rabban shimon ben gamliel. vachachamim omrim, kol zeman shehi bevet balah, gova chetubbatah leolam. kol zeman shehi bevet aviha, gova chetubbatah ad esrim vechamesh shanim. meta, yorsheha mazkirin ketubbatah ad esrim vechamesh shanim:

13.1: Shene dayyane gezerot hayu virushalayim, admon vechanan ben avishalom. chanan omer shene devarim, admon omer shiva. mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veishto tovaat mezonot, chanan omer, tishshava bassof velo tishshava battechilla. nechleku alav bene chohanim gedolim veamru, tishshava battechilla uvassof. amar rabbi dosa ven harekinas kedivrehem. amar rabban yochanan ben zakkay, yafe amar chanan, lo tishshava ella vassof:
13.2: Mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veamad echad ufirnes et ishto, chanan omer, ibbed et meotav. nechleku alav bene chohanim gedolim veamru, yishshava kamma hotzi veyittol. amar rabbi dosa ven harekinas kedivrehem. amar rabban yochanan ben zakkay, yafe amar chanan, hinniach meotav al keren hatztzevi:
13.3: Admon omer shiva. mi shemmet vehinniach banim uvanot, bizman shehannechasim merubbin, habbanim yorshim vehabbanot nizzonot. uvinchasim muatim, habbanot yizzonu vehabbanim yechazzeru al happetachim. admon omer, bishvil sheani zachar hifsadti. amar rabban gamliel, roe ani et divre admon:
13.4: Hattoen et chavero chadde shemen, vehoda vakkankannim, admon omer, hoil vehoda vemiktzat hattaana, yishshavea. vachachamim omrim, en zo hodaa mimmin hattaana. amar rabban gamliel, roe ani et divre admon:
13.5: Happosek maot lachatano ufashat lo et haregel, teshev ad sheyyalbin roshah. admon omer, yechola hi shettomar, illu ani fasakti leatzmi, eshev ad sheyyalbin roshi. achshav sheabba fasak alay, ma ani yechola laasot, o chenos o fetor. amar rabban gamliel, roe ani et divre admon:
13.6: Haorer al hassade vehu chatum aleha veed, admon omer, yachol hu sheyyomar, hashsheni noach li veharishon kashe hemennu. vachachamim omrim, ibbed et zechuto. asaah siman leacher, ibbed et zechuto:
13.7: Mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veavda derech sadehu, admon omer, yelech bakketzara. vachachamim omrim, yikne lo derech bemea mane, o yifrach baavir:
13.8: Hammotzi shetar chov al chavero, vehalla hotzi shemmachar lo et hassade, admon omer, yachol hu sheyyomar, illu hayiti chayyav lecha, haya lecha lehippara et shellecha keshemmacharta li et hassade. vachachamim omrim, ze haya fikkeach shemmachar lo et hakkarka, mippene shehu yachol lemashkeno:
13.9: Shenayim shehotziu shetar chov ze al ze, admon omer, illu hayiti chayyav lecha, ketzad atta love mimmenni. vachachamim omrim, ze gove shetar chovo veze gove shetar chovo:
13.10: Shalosh aratzot lannissuin, yehuda, veever hayyarden, vehaggalil. en motziin meir leir umikkerach lichrach. aval beotah haaretz, motziin meir leir umikkerach lichrach, aval lo meir lichrach velo mikkerach leir. motziin minnave haraa lenave hayyafa, aval lo minnave hayyafa lenave haraa. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af lo minnave raa lenave yafa, mippene shehannave hayyafa vodek:
13.11: Hakkol maalin leeretz yisrael, veen hakkol motziin. hakkol maalin lirushalayim, veen hakkol motziin, echad haanashim veechad hannashim (veechad avadim). nasa ishsha veeretz yisrael vegershah beeretz yisrael, noten lah mimmeot eretz yisrael. nasa ishsha veeretz yisrael vegershah bekappotkiyya, noten lah mimmeot eretz yisrael. nasa ishsha vekappotkiyya vegershah beeretz yisrael, noten lah mimmeot eretz yisrael. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, noten lah mimmeot kappotkiyya. nasa ishsha vekappotkiyya vegershah bekappotkiyya, noten lah mimmeot kappotkiyya:
